## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `target:v18` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T20:55Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2 + `target:v18`:** it is the consumer half objectstack#23967 (p1 + `target:v18`) names in its Done-when. Once the server stops inventing a `label`, the tab must fall back to a human string. Today's face is already the qualified name, so landing it later regresses nothing.
- **For the claimant:** The landing is `ObjectView.tsx` `viewTabLabel`: the object's label, or a localized default. ⛔ Never the qualified name.

Claim: PM loop round 6 (`priority:p2`, `target:v18`; triage grade `6224529682`)
Session: `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-12774-view-tab-label-fallback`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12774` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: the console's name for a view stored with no `label`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`: `viewTabLabel` (`:1007`–`:1015` at `main` `94b2489`), so a label-less view reads a human string (the object's label, or the console's localized default-list wording), never the qualified name; and every place that names a view the same way (the tabs it feeds and the back-link helper below it);
- language-pack keys only if the console has no existing wording for it;
- tests beside them;
- one `.changeset/12774-*.md` per touched released package.

Outside the surface: the server (objectstack PR #24013 already serves no invented `label`), authored and translated labels (unchanged), and the spec.

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: a console fallback stops showing a machine name. No prop or export changes. If the PR adds a language-pack key, the body says so and line 2 becomes `Clause-②: yes`, which the seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` ACCEPT covers.
Responsibility: `viewTabLabel` falls back to `view.name`; until objectstack PR #24013 the server's invented label hid it
Thread-read: 6224529682
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `94b2489`. No open PR names `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` (every open PR's file list was read). The server half (objectstack PR #24013, `aefab7c2c6`) has merged.

Posted by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`) verbatim from the cloud session's final message, because a cloud session cannot comment from its container. The seat filled `pr` with the draft PR it opened, #12804.

**The seat's answers:**
- **The open question: A.** The plural label for every label-less view is the back-link's existing rule, truthful for the measured default view, and needs no new key. Two label-less views reading alike is the author's to fix with a `label`, which the spec allows.
- **`out_of_scope_findings[0]` (class a) is filed as objectui#12805**: the app header titles a label-less view by `humanizeSlug(viewName)` on the `/view/NAME` route (`AppHeader.tsx:717` at `main`), so the header and the tab would name the same view two ways once the server stops inventing labels. Triage grades and routes it.
- **The other two findings** are recorded, not filed: the designer picker shows the machine name on purpose, and `useNavTargetLabel` leaves the fallback to its caller.
- **The seat read the diff** at `5c885e9`: `viewOriginLabel` folds into `viewTabLabel`, which now takes the fallback as a parameter; all four call sites (desktop tabs, mobile switcher, two back-links) pass `unlabelledViewText`. The catalogue lookup still runs first for derived views, and served labels are drawn as served. `Clause-②: no` stands.
- **NOT MEASURED (live)** is accepted: the published backend still invents a label equal to the name, so the fallback cannot show there; the 10-cell pin with its ablation is the reading.
- **The seat's edit:** the dev's footer line in the PR body is replaced with the provenance paragraph. Next: CI on `5c885e9`, then the ACCEPT.
